points.quote: `metadata` holds `version`, `role` (for example `'content'`) and the allowed `children`. / The flavour is a namespaced string such as `'affine:divider'`. (props not mentioned)
The model is a class that extends `BlockModel<Props>`. Here that is `DividerBlockModel`.
The view is a Lit element that extends `BlockComponent<Model>` ... `this.renderChildren(this.model)` renders child blocks. ... `BlockViewExtension('affine:divider', literal`affine-divider`)`

The providers are loaded through `StoreExtensionManager` and `ViewExtensionManager` ... `class DividerStoreExtension extends StoreExtensionProvider` ... `class DividerViewExtension extends ViewExtensionProvider`
`effect()` calls `effects()`, which defines the custom element. (per-scope registration not mentioned)
